terminus.finding: Heritage-management research separates first-line operational organizations, government governance/oversight and higher-level coordination, while the Wenmenglou financialization paper shows how a formally distributed urban process can still be driven by concentrated financial incentives and state-created development rights.
terminus.generated: LAYERED DISTRIBUTION MODEL: interface distribution and control distribution are still too coarse. At minimum separate (1) operational contact, (2) rule-setting, (3) resource allocation, and (4) veto/switching power. A system may distribute frontline work while centralizing the rules, money or final kill-switch. Therefore 'distributed' is not a property of the whole system; it is a property that must be measured layer by layer.
